Content to be populated by Builder from the Ironsworn SRD.

Source: TedTschopp/Ironsworn-SRD, Ironsworn SRD.md. Fetch in chunks of 40,000 characters (the file is 186KB). Extract all move descriptions from the Moves section. Preserve move names exactly as written.

Key move categories to extract:

  • Adventure moves: Face Danger, Secure an Advantage, Gather Information, Heal, Resupply, Make Camp, Undertake a Journey, Reach Your Destination
  • Relationship moves: Compel, Sojourn, Draw the Circle, Forge a Bond, Test Your Bond, Aid Your Ally, Write Your Epilogue
  • Combat moves: Enter the Fray, Strike, Clash, Turn the Tide, End the Fight, Battle
  • Suffer moves: Endure Harm, Endure Stress, Companion Endure Harm, Face Death, Face Desolation, Out of Supply
  • Quest moves: Swear an Iron Vow, Reach a Milestone, Fulfill Your Vow, Forsake Your Vow, Advance
  • Fate moves: Pay the Price, Ask the Oracle
